data.title: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
data.description: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.
data.author: Lee Ying Shan
